units.source_text: 出植物园，右边加茂川的堤岸上立着一排排松树。

en.t: After leaving the botanical garden, rows of pine trees stood along the bank of the Kamo River on the right.

units.source_text: 太吉郎率先穿过松林，下到河滩上。

en.t: Taikichiro led the way through the pine grove and went down onto the riverbank.

units.source_text: 虽叫河滩，其实就是一片长着嫩草的细长的绿野。

en.t: Though it was called a riverbank, it was really a long, narrow green field covered with tender grass.
Suddenly, the sound of flowing water came to them.
